# Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences & Research, Pune

> Leading pharmacy education institution in Pune offering B.Pharm, M.Pharm, D.Pharm, and specialized pharmaceutical sciences programs with AICTE accreditation and NIRF recognition.

Dr. D. Y. Patil IPSR is a premier pharmacy college located in Pimpri, Pune, affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University. The institute combines advanced infrastructure with strong academic governance, offering comprehensive pharmaceutical education and research opportunities.

## Key Topics

- B.Pharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy)
- M.Pharm (Master of Pharmacy)
- D.Pharm (Diploma in Pharmacy)
